actions_v2.description: A list of actions that take place when all required conditions and filters for the rule are met.

conditions.description: List of conditions. In JSON string format.

event_frequency.description: When the `comparison_type` is `count`, the number of events in an issue is more than `value` in `interval`. When the `comparison_type` is `percent`, the number of events in an issue is `value` % higher in `interval` compared to `comparison_interval` ago.

event_frequency_percent.description: When the `comparison_type` is `count`, the percent of sessions affected by an issue is more than `value` in `interval`. When the `comparison_type` is `percent`, the percent of sessions affected by an issue is `value` % higher in `interval` compared to `comparison_interval` ago.

event_unique_user_frequency.description: When the `comparison_type` is `count`, the number of users affected by an issue is more than `value` in `interval`. When the `comparison_type` is `percent`, the number of users affected by an issue is `value` % higher in `interval` compared to `comparison_interval` ago.

existing_high_priority_issue.description: Sentry marks an existing issue as high priority.

new_high_priority_issue.description: Sentry marks a new issue as high priority.

reappeared_event.description: The issue changes state from ignored to unresolved.

regression_event.description: The issue changes state from resolved to unresolved.

conditions_v2.description: A list of triggers that determine when the rule fires.

environment.description: Perform issue alert in a specific environment.

filter_match.description: A string determining which filters need to be true before any actions take place. Required when a value is provided for `filters`.

filters.description: A list of filters that determine if a rule fires after the necessary conditions have been met. In JSON string format.

age_comparison.description: The issue is older or newer than `value` `time`.

assigned_to.description: The issue is assigned to no one, team, or member.

issue_category.description: The issue's category is equal to `value`.

issue_occurrences.description: The issue has happened at least `value` times (Note: this is approximate).

latest_adopted_release.description: The {oldest_or_newest} adopted release associated with the event's issue is {older_or_newer} than the latest adopted release in {environment}.

latest_release.description: The event is from the latest release.

filters_v2.description: A list of filters that determine if a rule fires after the necessary conditions have been met.

frequency.description: Perform actions at most once every `X` minutes for this issue.

owner.description: The ID of the team or user that owns the rule.
